endpoint_definition: exact endpoint_definition copied from the reviewed modeling task
notes: Draft hypotheses for G3 review; no mechanism is considered established.

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Condition-mediated system response
mechanism_hypotheses.hypothesis_statement: the first condition changes an intermediate system state and thereby modifies the response to the second condition
proposed_process_chain: first condition changes an intermediate system state
the intermediate state modifies the response pathway
the altered hydration changes the measured endpoint
mechanism_hypotheses.scope_statement: Only within the exact system scope, endpoint, and input ranges represented by the linked evidence.
predicted_observations: a measurable intermediate-state change across the first condition
a corresponding change in interfacial hydration
alternative_explanations: an unmeasured covariate correlated with both conditions
unresolved_variables: realized rather than nominal condition state

evidence_assessments.interpretation_summary: A directly measured process observable changes with the condition pair.
A calculation supports the proposed intermediate process.
A measured result does not show the predicted process change.
